description: Schema for the authority state envelope — the resolved admissible execution authority passed forward once authority evaluation succeeds

actor_id.description: Fully qualified identifier of the actor whose authority was evaluated

authenticated_actor_state.description: Resolved authentication state for the actor; opaque to execution

authorized_workflows.description: List of workflow FQDNs the actor is authorized to invoke

visibility_scope.description: Projection visibility constraints for the actor; governs what the actor may observe

trace_scope.description: Trace visibility constraints for the actor; governs what trace data the actor may access

authority_provenance.description: Provenance record for this authority state: source, timestamp, chain of authority

source.description: Authority source identifier (e.g., authorization DB path or authority issuer)
